description: Stereo Merge Split: a merge section putting a left and a right signal into one polyphonic cable, and beneath it a split section taking such a cable back apart

inputs.text: The left side of the pair to be merged, up to 8 channels; its channels come out first on the STEREO output
The right side of the pair to be merged, up to 8 channels; its channels follow the left ones on the STEREO output, and unpatched it reads the LEFT input channel for channel
The polyphonic cable to be taken apart, its first half going to the LEFT output and its second half to the RIGHT output

outputs.text: The left and right inputs one after the other in a single cable, at twice the channel count of the wider of the two; the lamp beside it glows red when either input brought more than 8 channels
The first half of the SPLIT STEREO input's channels; an odd channel count gives this output the extra one
The second half of the SPLIT STEREO input's channels, padded with a 0V channel when the input's channel count is odd

notes: a signal patched to the LEFT input alone comes out of the STEREO output on both sides, so a mono source becomes a centred stereo pair
the two sections are independent: the merge section does not feed the split section

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the LEFT input.
